headline: Hunter brace sends AFC Toronto into the NSL final
detail: AFC Toronto won 4–0 at Ottawa Rapid (8–2 on aggregate) in the semi-final second leg. Kaylee Hunter scored twice in the first half, then Lena Silano and Nikayla Small added goals. The final is on 14 Nov at TD Place.

headline: Fleuriau Chateau hat-trick sends Atlético Ottawa past Forge into the CPL final
detail: Atlético Ottawa won 3–2 in Hamilton (5–4 on aggregate). Nicolas Fleuriau Chateau scored at 25', 84' and the winner deep in stoppage time, two minutes after Dan Nimick's penalty had levelled for Forge; Hoce Massunda also scored for Forge. Ottawa face Cavalry or FC Supra in the final.

headline: Davies off the bench as Bayern win 2–1 at Mainz
detail: Alphonso Davies came off the bench as Bayern won 2–1 at Mainz. Kimmich (14') and Lennart Karl (57') scored, both set up by Kane, before Tietz's stoppage-time header. Manuel Neuer went off injured in the first half.

headline: Marsch "super excited" to have 18-year-old Kevin Khan in camp
detail: Feyenoord midfielder Kevin Khan, a former Canada U17 captain who played at the 2025 U17 World Cup, has his first senior call-up for the Guatemala tie. He has not played for Feyenoord's first team yet, and Marsch hinted he may not feature.

headline: Goodman makes his case in goal for Canada
detail: Owen Goodman, 22, has started all 12 matches since his loan from Crystal Palace to Dundee, with two clean sheets in 11 Scottish Premiership games. He kept a clean sheet on his Canada debut against Peru in October and is in the squad for Guatemala with Crépeau and St. Clair.

headline: Concacaf expands the 2027 Gold Cup group stage
detail: The 2027 Gold Cup (17 June to 11 July) will have two groups of eight, with the top four in each reaching the quarter-finals. Canada's direct route in is to beat Guatemala in the Nations League quarter-final this month.

headline: Marsch backs Promise David's Brighton development
detail: Jesse Marsch says he and Brighton head coach Fabian Hürzeler are aligned on Promise David's development. David has played 78 minutes in four appearances this season and is in Canada's squad for the Nations League quarter-final with Guatemala.

headline: Marsch: Saliba is ready for bigger challenges
detail: Jesse Marsch praised Nathan Saliba's quick adaptation at Villarreal after his summer move from Anderlecht, ahead of Canada's Nations League quarter-final with Guatemala. Saliba has missed three matches with a minor muscle problem but is expected to be available for the first leg.

headline: Marsch wants Davies further up the pitch for Canada
detail: Jesse Marsch said Canada would like to play Alphonso Davies further forward against Guatemala, after Bayern have used him on the wing with Díaz and Gnabry injured. Even at full-back, he would push higher in build-up.

headline: Davies back as Marsch names Canada's squad for Guatemala
detail: Alphonso Davies returns for the Nations League quarter-final (13 Nov in Guatemala City, 16 Nov at BMO Field). Vice-captain Stephen Eustáquio (groin) and Cyle Larin (hamstring) are out injured; 18-year-old Kevin Khan of Feyenoord earns a place.

headline: Birmingham beat Millwall 3–0, Millar plays
detail: Alex Cochrane (inside a minute), Max Bird and Jay Stansfield scored inside the first half hour at St Andrew's. Liam Millar played and went close to a fourth in the first half.

headline: Davies wins the Canadian duel as Bayern beat Atlético 2–0
detail: Lennart Karl (54') and Konrad Laimer (74') scored at the Metropolitano in Champions League matchday 4. Alphonso Davies started and played 79 minutes for Bayern; Jonathan David came off the bench for Atlético in the second half.

headline: PSG hit Villarreal for six, Buchanan starts
detail: PSG scored four times in the first 17 minutes, a Champions League record, and won 6–0 at the Estadio de la Cerámica. Tajon Buchanan started on the right for Villarreal; Tani Oluwaseyi was on the bench.

headline: Dates set for Canada's November Concacaf games
detail: The CanMNT play Guatemala in the Nations League quarter-final on 13 Nov in Guatemala City (21:00 ET) and 16 Nov at BMO Field (20:00 ET). The CanWNT open the W Championship against Panama on 28 Nov in Mansfield, Texas: a win secures a place at the 2027 Women's World Cup.

headline: Alidou scores and assists as Roses win 3–0 at Vancouver Rise
detail: Elyse Bennett opened the scoring from Marie-Yasmine Alidou's pass, Alidou doubled the lead and substitute Lisa Pechersky made it 3–0 in the first leg of the NSL semi-final at Swangard Stadium. The second leg is at Stade Boréale on 8 Nov.

headline: Atlanta beat TFC 3–1, Toronto's playoff hopes are over
detail: Almirón (22'), Cooper Sanchez (40') and Miranchuk (52') put Atlanta 3–0 up before Lewis Morgan pulled one back (79'). The defeat ends Toronto FC's playoff hopes with one game left, at Philadelphia on Saturday.

headline: Whitecaps thrash Seattle 5–1, White reaches 100 club goals
detail: Brian White scored after 57 seconds and again on 53', with Gauld (9'), Laborda (43') and Cvetković (69') also scoring at BC Place; Jordan Morris replied for Seattle. The Western Conference champions completed a Cascadia sweep and visit CF Montréal on Decision Day, 7 Nov.

headline: FC Supra beat Cavalry 2–1 in their first-ever playoff game
detail: Zachary Brault-Guillard scored after 4 minutes and an Eryk Kobza own goal (9') doubled the lead at Stade Boréale. Tobias Warschewski pulled one back from the spot in first-half stoppage time. The second leg is in Calgary on Saturday.

headline: Atlético Ottawa and Forge draw 2–2 in CPL semi-final first leg
detail: All four goals came before half-time at TD Place: Aromatario (15') and Jevremović (35', free kick) for Forge, Gutiérrez (23') and Tabla (43') for Ottawa. TNB partners Tavernier and Bruno did not start. The second leg is in Hamilton on Saturday.

headline: Ríos rescues late 1–1 for CF Montréal at NYCFC
detail: Andrés Perea put NYCFC ahead (41'), but Daniel Ríos finished Luca Petrasso's cross two minutes into stoppage time to knock NYCFC out of the playoff race. Alexis Sánchez started. Montréal host the Whitecaps on Decision Day, 7 Nov.

headline: Hunter scores twice as AFC Toronto beat Ottawa 4–2
detail: Kaylee Hunter scored (26', 67') and set up April Lantaigne's opener as AFC Toronto won the first leg of their NSL semi-final 4–2. Lena Silano also scored; Choo Hyo-joo and Keera Melenhorst replied for Ottawa Rapid. The second leg is in Ottawa on 7 Nov.

headline: Late Silva goal holds Bayern 2–2 in Der Klassiker
detail: Laimer (38') and Upamecano (66') scored for Bayern, but Guirassy (60') and Fábio Silva (89') earned Dortmund a draw at the Allianz Arena. Alphonso Davies started.

headline: Eustáquio scores in Swansea's 4–0 win over Blackburn
detail: Stephen Eustáquio tapped in the opener (12') as Swansea beat Blackburn 4–0 at the Swansea.com Stadium. Opoku, Lissah and Ross Stewart also scored.

headline: Atlético win 2–0 at Levante and go top
detail: Grimaldo (36') and Giuliano Simeone (62') scored as Atlético Madrid won at the Ciutat de València to go top of LaLiga. Jonathan David came off the bench in the second half.

headline: Birmingham win 3–1 at Lincoln, Millar starts
detail: August Priske scored twice (16', 60') and Alex Cochrane added a third (73') after Tom Bayliss had pulled one back (63') as Birmingham won 3–1 at Lincoln in the Championship. Liam Millar started on the wing.

headline: Guatemala's stadium partly closed for Canada tie
detail: Concacaf fined Guatemala and ordered a 25 percent partial stadium closure for their next home Nations League match after discriminatory chants and crowd trouble vs Suriname on 2 Oct. That match is the first leg of the quarter-final against Canada on 13 Nov; the second leg is at BMO Field on 16 Nov.

headline: Villarreal beaten 1–0 at home by Espanyol
detail: Leandro Cabrera scored the only goal (60') as Espanyol won at the Estadio de la Cerámica. Tajon Buchanan started for Villarreal and Tani Oluwaseyi came off the bench late on.

headline: Kadeisha Buchanan heads in Chelsea's second vs Roma
detail: Kadeisha Buchanan headed in Wieke Kaptein's cross a minute from time to seal Chelsea's 2–0 Women's Champions League win over Roma at Plough Lane on matchday three.

headline: Whitecaps beat San Diego 4–1, Müller returns
detail: Cvetkovic, Brian White (his 100th MLS goal), Gauld and Caicedo scored as Vancouver beat San Diego FC 4–1 at BC Place. Thomas Müller came on at 74' in his first game since his 6 Oct hamstring injury.

headline: Sargent winner as TFC beat D.C. United 2–1
detail: Toronto FC came from behind at BMO Field: Andre Dozzell put D.C. ahead (29'), Jonathan Osorio levelled after a VAR check (64') and Josh Sargent tapped in the rebound from Theo Corbeanu's shot off the post (86').

headline: CF Montréal beaten 4–0 at Charlotte
detail: Liel Abada scored a hat-trick (67', 79', 83') after Idan Toklomati's early opener as Charlotte beat CF Montréal 4–0. Alexis Sánchez came off the bench at 63'.

headline: Davies scores and assists in 6–1 Pokal win
detail: Alphonso Davies came on at half-time, won the penalty for Olise's second, scored Bayern's fourth (70') and set up Nathaniel Brown (73') as Bayern beat Magdeburg 6–1 to reach the DFB-Pokal last 16.

headline: Johnston out until after the break
detail: Celtic manager Martin O'Neill said Alistair Johnston's new hamstring problem is not the same injury and should be shorter, but he can't see him playing before the mid-November international break. That puts Canada's Nations League quarter-final against Guatemala in doubt.

headline: Oluwaseyi scores as Villarreal win 5–0
detail: Tani Oluwaseyi started and scored Villarreal's second goal (26') in a 5–0 Copa del Rey first-round win at fifth-tier CE Manacor. Tajon Buchanan stayed on the bench; Nathan Saliba is still injured.
